game.name: Granny
game.rules:
These rules apply for every category, please ask the moderators for classification on anything

# **General**

- Glitches are allowed, except for Any% Glitchless
- A run must have at least 1 glitch to be submitted into Any%, otherwise Any% Glitchless
- It's preferred to submit to the correct Difficulty, Version, and Ending
- Extra locks, Music, Darker, Nightmare, Quality settings, and the Secret ending(s) are all optional
- Emulators are allowed
- Auto clickers are banned
- All modifications, except for the ones in [Resources](/granny/resources), are not allowed, including texture mods, mod menus, etc
- If your run's video gets removed after verification it will be rejected (if its a top 3), unless your account has been terminated and you didn't remove the video, it will remain
- If you were caught cheating 3 times, you'll be **banned** from speedrunning Granny games (impart of Granny (PC)).

---

# **Timing**

- Please view "Category Rules" for the timing rules
- Moderators will retime your run for you
- Adverts do not affect your final time
- If your run includes adverts, they must be shown, you can blur them
- You could turn off internet to stop them from playing
- Time always starts when you gain control of the player

- **v1.7.4+**: When joystick appears

- **<=v1.7.3**: When the screen jolts up after waking up

- **v1.0**: When the screen moves a bit

---

# **Proof Requirements**

- Video proof is required
- Audio is not needed, but is preferred.
- Any file/video hosting platform is allowed, YouTube is preferred
- Video must start before the controls appear
- A 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place run **MUST** contain all of these, additionally with audio must be recorded, run must be uploaded on YouTube/Twitch, and the video quality ***should*** be good

---

# **List of Glitches**

These all count as glitches:

- Anything that makes you go out of bounds for a long period of time
- [Sewer Switch Skip](https://youtu.be/h3g8p2zCqEI)
- Pushing items through walls, impart from the basement tunnel bars on Extreme mode
- Skipping any part of the game

These are all not glitches:

- Walking through doors
- Avoiding floor creaks by using methods to get around them

newsList.title: We're banning cheaters from speedrunning!
newsList.body:
Since there has been cheaters expanding recently, me and the other Granny moderators chose to make a poll in [Granny Speedrunning Discord server](https://discord.gg/vzu23VRT9P) about if we should ban cheaters, and the poll ended up choosing to ban them.

# So what's gonna happen?

From now on, if so

categories.name: Shotgun Granny
categories.rules:
## **Goal**

- You need to assemble and shoot Granny with the shotgun
- This is also known as [American%](/granny_pc?h=American&x=zd3j7p82) in Granny (PC)

## **Timing**

- Time starts when the screen jolts up after waking up (for **v1.7.4+**, When the joystick appears)
- Time stops when the "Granny is now gone" text appears

## **Version**

- 1.4+

categories.name: Chop the Melon
categories.rules:
## **Goal**

- You need to chop the melon with the guillotine

## **Timing**

- Time starts when the screen jolts up after waking up (or when the joystick appears in **v1.7.4+**)
- Time stops when the hand disappears after pulling the lever on the guillotine

## **Presets**

- A preset is where all the different items spawn, they usually change every game
- All presets are allowed
- If your melon is in one of these places then submit to "Easy Presets", otherwise "Hard Presets"
- **v1.8+:** preset 2 (Kitchen)
- **v1.7 through v1.7.9.3:** presets 1 and 2 (Backyard and Kitchen)
- **<=v1.6.1:** presets 1, 2 and 5 (Backyard, Kitchen and Bathroom)

## **Version**

- 1.3+

categories.name: Cut Wires
categories.rules:
## **Goal**

- You must cut all the 3 wires with the Cutting pliers (or A chain cutter), it doesn't matter in what order you cut them
- The Basement wire, Door wire and the Jail wire

## **Glitches**

- Glitches are only allowed in Any%
- A run must have at least 1 glitch to be submitted into it
- Please view "Game Rules" for more info on glitches

## **Timing**

- Time starts when the screen jolts up after waking up (for **v1.7.4+**. When the joystick appears)
- Time ends when the final wire has been cut

## **Version**

- 1.2+

categories.name: Hungry Pets
categories.rules:
## **Goal**

- Feed all of Granny's pets
- Bird seed to Crow
- Meat to Spider

## **Timing**

- Time starts when the screen jolts up after waking up (for **v1.7.4+**, When the joystick appears)
- Time ends when the Bird seed or Meat has been placed down

## **Version**

- 1.7+

categories.name: Slendrina%
categories.rules:
## **Goal**

- The aim is to get to the Crib with Teddy and summon Slendrina
- You can summon Slendrina by dropping Teddy into the Crib

## **Timing**

- Time starts when the screen jolts up after waking up (for **v1.7.4+**, When the joystick appears)
- Time ends when Teddy turns white after being dropped into the Crib

## **Glitches**

- Glitches are only allowed in Any%
- A run must have at least 1 glitch to be submitted into it
- Please view "Game Rules" for more info on glitches

## **Version**

- 1.3+

categories.name: Game Over%
categories.rules:
## **Goal**

- The goal is to get to day 5 (or 6) and die as fast as you can

## **Timing**

- Time starts when the screen jolts up after waking up (for **v1.7.4+**, When the joystick appears)
- Time ends when the joystick disappears on the last day after dying

## **Version**

- Normal - 1.0+
- Easy - 1.1+
- Hard - 1.2+
- Extreme - 1.3+
- Practice - 1.5+
